reason: I buy my bread and a few things at the dekkene every morning, and the owner is my neighbour and lets me pay at the end of the month. I do not drive, so a pickup point and a 6 to 8 evening window do not fit how I shop, and I have no cash to spare for a fee.
objection: I need things the same day, in small amounts, and sometimes on credit. Here I must send a list before 2, collect in the evening, pay cash or Whish on the spot, and add $2 every bag. For my small purchases that fee eats the saving.
would_change_my_mind: Delivery to my door and a monthly tab like my neighbour gives me, with no fee on small bags.
